node.statement: Set eta_0:=eta_K and C:=K+4*sqrt(2*K). The first child gives eta_0>0. Also K>=1 implies 2*K>0, so the real principal square root sqrt(2*K) is nonnegative and C>=K>=1>0. Because eta_0 and C are fixed expressions in the universal dimension-free scalars K and eta_K, they too are universal and independent of n.
